questions.question: Which of the following is true about RDDs?

options.text: They can be modified after creation.
They do not support fault tolerance.
They are only used in batch processing.

questions.explanation: RDDs (Resilient Distributed Datasets) are immutable and provide fault tolerance.

questions.explanation: You must create a Spark session first, then load data, perform transformations, and finally trigger actions.

questions.question: Shuffles can negatively impact performance due to data movement.
questions.explanation: Shuffles require data to be moved across the network, which can slow down processing.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using broadcast joins?

options.text: They are faster for large datasets.

questions.explanation: Broadcast joins reduce the amount of data shuffled across the network by broadcasting the smaller dataset to all nodes.
